title: Halo Dental
description: Warm cream paper with pure black ink and 1px black rules, white cards, and one hot orange for square-cornered buttons carrying black text; a yellow-to-red pair for gradient headlines. A single wide grotesk at regular weight. Dark sibling: warm near-black page with pure black stage panels and white text.
notes: light is the faithful mode; the original's black panels use this theme's dark palette locally (a `dark` class on the panel)
Manrope stands in for the original's commercial Nuckle; everything is weight 400
gutter and section spacing are fluid clamp() values: 21px / ~70px on phones, 40px / ~128px at 1440
highlight + glow are the gradient pair (yellow → red)
